# Changelog

## 3.0.0

- Re-audited all 130 parent races and 106 canonical subtypes after the full sequence of heritage-rule messages.
- Rebuilt compatibility as a provenance-preserving graph rather than a compressed family-only result.
- Applied Nebyrr's creator-family bridges to every qualifying race pair, not only one representative per category.
- Preserved Sea Elf as the exact Merfolk/Tamhiogal subtype seed.
- Preserved Lizardfolk ↔ Grung and Lizardfolk ↔ every Dril'thar bloodline as exact seeds.
- Added repeated transitive closure, shortest compatibility paths, rule precedence, and explicit exclusion infrastructure.
- Added compatibility-chain display to the generator UI.
- Revalidated 6,670 biological, 44 assisted, and 1,671 excluded race pairs.
